name: Zellij
summary: Terminal workspace/multiplexer in Rust with KDL config, declarative layouts, built-in tab and status bars, floating/stacked panes and WASM plugins. Native on Windows since 0.44.
startupCostMs: Not measured here (binary not run on this machine). Zellij starts a server plus built-in WASM plugin panes (tab-bar, status-bar), so it is heavier than tmux at start; it is a one-time cost per session, not per shell.

install.notes: Verified on this machine: Zellij.Zellij 0.46.0 (publisher Zellij Contributors). `zellij-org.zellij` does not exist; another listing `arndawg.zellij-windows` is a third-party build.

windows.notes: Native Windows builds arrived in 0.44.0 (MSI installer and zip on GitHub releases; also `irm https://zellij.dev/launch.ps1 | iex`). Config dir is unclear across versions: the docs search --config-dir, ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR, then $HOME/.config/zellij; reports for 0.44 say %USERPROFILE%\.config\zellij is used in some builds and %APPDATA%\Zellij\config in others. Run `zellij setup --check` to see the real [CONFIG DIR], or pin it with $env:ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR. Zellij picks the pane shell from $env:SHELL before default_shell (reported); set default_shell "pwsh" and check. validate argv is from the docs (global --config flag + `setup --check`) and was not run here; the exit code on a bad config is unverified.

macos.notes: Config search order: --config-dir, ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR, $HOME/.config/zellij, then the Application Support default, then /etc/zellij.

linux.notes: Not in Debian main or Fedora main (checked). Alternatives: `bash <(curl -L https://zellij.dev/launch)`, `cargo binstall zellij`, `cargo install --locked zellij`, or the release tarball. musl builds do not include the Zellij terminal (`zellij terminal`).

plugins.notes: WASM/WASI plugins, Rust officially; built-in UI is itself plugins.

sources: winget show --id Zellij.Zellij; scoop search zellij (machine, 2026-11-23)
